svg.title: Create, restore, retire
svg.desc: Snapshot IDs persist in the superblock; /snapshot itself stays outside the captured tree. Labels are outlined Noto Sans.

g.aria-label: Tree operations take snapshot_lock and use begin_op() / end_op(); filesystem writes use inode locks.

g.aria-label: Device files are excluded. Crash-atomic snapshots and concurrent-writer consistency are not established.
